correctness.rationale: The integral companion matrix has determinant 1 and characteristic polynomial X^3-X^2-1. Modulo 3 it decomposes into order-2 and order-8 factors. The scalar 3-adic root has valuation one in lambda^2-1. The exact identity M^8-I=3B with det B=1 supplies valuation-one lifting for both factors, yielding fixed-point counts 3^(r+1) and 3^(3r+3), truncated at k. Primitive-cycle subtraction proves the exact formula for all k. All 551880 finite state instances at k=1..4 were separately enumerated with exact counts.

evidence: Lin 2021 discusses negative indices and convolution; Guadalupe 2021 studies the standard Narayana number 3-adic valuation. A dyadic generalized Narayana full orbit census has a different prime and cannot imply the 3-adic decomposition.

value.rationale: The natural full-space orbit invariant of a classical third-order number-theoretic recurrence is completely determined at all powers of three. The classification identifies a unique 3-adically lifting short-cycle tower, a sharply quantified family of full-length orbits, and exact total cycles, information absent from a one-seed Pisano period or a valuation table.
